name: nested-microfrontend-demo
description: Nested microfrontend demo: Parent -> MFE A -> MFE B

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix apps/parent-app && npm install --prefix apps/mfe-a && npm install --prefix apps/mfe-b
scripts.dev: concurrently -n parent,mfe-a,mfe-b -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:parent" "npm run dev:mfe-a" "npm run dev:mfe-b"
scripts.build: npm run build:parent && npm run build:mfe-a && npm run build:mfe-b
